summary: Redesigns the audit-log page appended to completed e-signed PDFs: logo header, 'Audit Logs' title, the file name, and a 'Document history' list with human-readable action labels (Signed / Email sent / Document completed) next to each summary; also marks @react-pdf/renderer as a server external package so the PDF renderer works on the server.

statements.text: The agent also changed next.config.js, which doesn't look related to what you asked for. (This is a guess.)
statements.why: The next.config.js change adds @react-pdf/renderer to experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages (next.config.js:49), the library the audit-log template renders with (src/server/esign.ts renderToBuffer). It is directly related to the audit-log PDF work, not a stray edit.

misses.what: The audit-log page attached to every completed signed document now looks different for signers and the company: logo, file name row, and a 'Document history' table pairing a plain-English action (Signed, Email sent, Document completed) with each log line.
The time of each event (occurredAt) is now fetched but not printed in the audit log; the history shows only action + summary text.
